John M. Baker wrote:
>
> Don't forget that Stake was removed and Wooden Stake
> was added.

Several cards were renamed, yes.
I didn't think it was important to this thread.

The changes listed in the Duelist article (#7) are:

Stake bacame Wooden Stake (and was rewritten).
Gangrel De-Evolution became Gangel Atavism (and was reworded).
Kine Dominance became Dominate Kine (and was reworded).

Other changes that appear on the spoiler list include:

The Spirit's Touch became Spirit's Touch.
Eco Terrorists became Ecoterrorists.
Tiberius, Scandalmonger became Tiberius, The Scandalmonger.
Tusk, Talebearer became Tusk, The Talebearer.
